statBlock.name: Monodrone
statBlock.description: A winged Mechanus worker that can perform one simple task at a time and relay a message of at most 48 words.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the modron to go against its nature or instructions.
Disintegration. At death, the modron crumbles into dust. Its weapons and other possessions remain.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30/120-ft. range, one target. Hit 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

ruleNotes: The 2014 errata corrects the monodrone's Javelin to +2 to hit and 3 (1d6) damage. The first printing has +3 to hit and 4 (1d6 + 1).

statBlock.name: Pentadrone
statBlock.description: A five-armed supervisor of Mechanus's laborers. It can improvise when a situation changes.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the modron to go against its nature or instructions.
Disintegration. At death, the modron crumbles into dust. Its weapons and other possessions remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make five Arm attacks.
Arm. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Paralysis Gas (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure it is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.

statBlock.name: Quadrone
statBlock.description: A winged Mechanus field officer that can fire four arrows in a turn.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the modron to go against its nature or instructions.
Disintegration. At death, the modron crumbles into dust. Its weapons and other possessions remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks or four Shortbow attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 80/320-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Rogue Modron
statBlock.classification: Construct, any alignment except lawful neutral
statBlock.description: A modron cut off from Primus's directives. Other modrons hunt rogues.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose one rank below. Use that rank's size, stats, challenge, senses, and attacks. The rogue loses Axiomatic Mind and has an alignment other than lawful neutral. All ranks have natural armor, truesight 120 ft., and the Modron language. Ability scores below are listed in Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma order.
sections.Traits: Disintegration. At death, the modron crumbles into dust. Its weapons and other possessions remain.
sections.Actions: Use the attacks and special actions of the chosen rank below.
sections.Monodrone:

Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30/120-ft. range, one target. Hit 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
sections.Duodrone:

sections.Tridrone:

sections.Quadrone:

statBlock.name: Myconid Adult
statBlock.description: An Underdark fungus that lives in a myconid circle. These creatures usually welcome peaceful visitors.

sections.Languages: None. Rapport Spores allow telepathic communication.
sections.Traits:
Distress Spores. When the myconid takes damage, other myconids within 240 ft. sense its pain.
Sun Sickness. Sunlight gives it disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saves. More than 1 hour in direct sunlight kills it.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Pacifying Spores (3/day). Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure it is Stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 20-ft. radius. They spread around corners and affect creatures with Intelligence 2 or higher, excluding constructs, elementals, and undead. For 1 hour, affected creatures can speak telepathically to each other within 30 ft.

statBlock.name: Myconid Sovereign
statBlock.description: The largest myconid in a colony leads its circles and can animate corpses as spore servants.

sections.Languages: None. Rapport Spores allow telepathic communication.
sections.Traits:
Distress Spores. When the myconid takes damage, other myconids within 240 ft. sense its pain.
Sun Sickness. Sunlight gives it disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saves. More than 1 hour in direct sunlight kills it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use either Hallucination Spores or Pacifying Spores, then make a Fist attack.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 8 (3d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage.
Animating Spores (3/day). Release spores at one humanoid corpse or one corpse of a Large or smaller beast within 5 ft. After 24 hours it rises as a spore servant. It remains animated for 1d4 + 1 weeks or until destroyed. This action cannot animate the same corpse again.
Hallucination Spores. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned and Incapacitated by hallucinations for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Pacifying Spores. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it is Stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. radius. They spread around corners and affect creatures with Intelligence 2 or higher, excluding constructs, elementals, and undead. For 1 hour, affected creatures can speak telepathically to each other within 30 ft.
sections.Spore servant template:
Use the template for a Large or smaller creature that once had flesh and blood. Keep its AC, HP, Hit Dice, Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, vulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities. Its type becomes Plant, its tags fall away, and its alignment becomes unaligned. Reduce each speed by 10 ft., to a minimum of 5 ft. Set Intelligence to 2, Wisdom to 6, and Charisma to 1.
Remove the creature's original saving throw and skill bonuses, special senses, traits, and languages. Give it blindsight 30 ft., with blindness beyond that range, and immunity to Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, and Paralyzed. It takes orders through a myconid's Rapport Spores and prioritizes orders from the most powerful myconid.
Keep Multiattack and melee weapon attacks that deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. Drop any other damage types unless they come from equipment. If the servant cannot otherwise deal damage, it can make an unarmed strike for 1d4 + its Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, or 2d4 + its Strength modifier if Large.

statBlock.name: Myconid Sprout
statBlock.description: A young myconid with enough rapport spores to let nearby creatures speak mind to mind.

sections.Languages: None. Rapport Spores allow telepathic communication.
sections.Traits:
Distress Spores. When the myconid takes damage, other myconids within 240 ft. sense its pain.
Sun Sickness. Sunlight gives it disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saves. More than 1 hour in direct sunlight kills it.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 1 (1d4 − 1) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.
Rapport Spores (3/day). Release spores in a 10-ft. radius. They spread around corners and affect creatures with Intelligence 2 or higher, excluding constructs, elementals, and undead. For 1 hour, affected creatures can speak telepathically to each other within 30 ft.

statBlock.name: Quaggoth Spore Servant
statBlock.description: A dead quaggoth animated by a myconid sovereign's spores. Its main weapons are its claws.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft., blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 8.
sections.Languages: None. The servant follows orders received through myconid Rapport Spores and prioritizes the most powerful myconid.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
